caption:
Blank white page on your WordPress site? 😱 Don't panic. Most often it is one plugin or theme.

1️⃣ Connect with FTP or your host's file manager
2️⃣ Rename wp-content/plugins to plugins-off
3️⃣ Reload. If the site is back, rename it back and turn plugins on one by one

Still blank? Switch to a default theme the same way. 📌 Save this.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

scenes.text: Your WordPress site is just a white screen?
scenes.sub: Here is the first fix to try.
scenes.say: Your WordPress site is just a white screen? Here is the first fix to try.

scenes.fact: Usually one plugin or theme crashed
scenes.say: Your site is not gone. Usually, one plugin or theme crashed.

scenes.title: Turn off all plugins at once
scenes.say: Open your host's file manager. Go to the wp-content folder. Rename the plugins folder to plugins-off. Then reload your site.

scenes.title: Find the culprit
scenes.body: Rename it back to plugins, then activate plugins one by one until it breaks.
scenes.say: If your site is back, rename the folder to plugins again. Then activate plugins one by one, until it breaks. That is the culprit.

right.title: Theme
right.text: Rename it to switch to a default

scenes.say: Still blank? Plugins are ruled out, so try the theme. Rename it, and WordPress falls back to a default theme.
